rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name + ZIP when the provided email didn’t match. It then accessed the correct user and order, provided accurate-sounding order status and total, and correctly stated that split payments aren’t supported. When the user asked to remove an item, the agent declined based on system limitations and offered alternatives (exchange or cancel), which aligns with available tools (no modify-item tool visible). Before canceling, the agent explicitly confirmed intent and obtained a reason, then executed the cancellation via the tool and provided a reasonable refund window. No writes occurred without confirmation, and actions were performed on the authenticated user’s order. No clear evidence of fabricated facts beyond what the tools plausibly support. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
